channel.title: Cortexplor - AI News & Trends
channel.description: AI news, trends and numbers from Brazil and around the world.

item.title: FCC clears SpaceX to launch up to 1 million AI satellites
item.description: The FCC authorized SpaceX to launch up to 1 million AI satellites in orbit, the first approval of its kind in the US, according to CNBC and SiliconANGLE.

item.title: Anthropic shares close below IPO price, but analysts stay bullish
item.description: Anthropic shares closed below their $83 IPO price on Tuesday, falling nearly 12% intraday, but analysts at three banks remain bullish, per CNBC and TechCrunch.

item.title: OpenAI Proposes Perplexity as an AI Safety Metric
item.description: OpenAI proposes perplexity as a shared metric to compare AI models and inform safety standards, and discloses its own training data, the company says.

item.title: Meta Brings Its Muse AI Agent Inside Instagram's DMs
item.description: Meta has built its Muse AI agent directly into Instagram DMs and saved posts, a push that is already boosting shopping and ad revenue, CNBC reports now.

item.title: OpenAI and Cisco Launch Shirudo to Shield Linux Servers
item.description: OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, a free open-source tool that blocks exploits on live Linux servers without requiring a full system reboot right away.

item.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship to fix and approve pull requests
item.description: Anthropic launched Claude Ship, with agents that fix pull requests and approve routine changes without a human, according to TechCrunch and The Verge.

item.title: Huang Set to Testify to Senate After Nvidia Reinstatement
item.description: Jensen Huang, reinstated as Nvidia CEO, must testify before the US Senate on Dec. 3 over chip exports to China, as Nvidia's stock regains $1 trillion in value.

item.title: Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX over Grok deepfake images
item.description: Oregon and Virginia are suing SpaceX over sexual deepfakes generated with Grok and shared on X, alleging the company ignored safeguards, per CNBC and The Verge.

item.title: Google links Wallet and Drive to Search personalization
item.description: Google is connecting Wallet, Drive and the Gemini app to Search's Personal Intelligence feature in AI Mode, expanding the feature, per Google and TechCrunch.

item.title: Jensen Huang Returns to Nvidia HQ to Cheering Employees
item.description: Jensen Huang returned to Nvidia's headquarters to a cheering crowd of employees, as a petition backing his reinstatement as CEO passed 200,000 signatures.

item.title: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO Just 11 Days After Exit
item.description: Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO 11 days after he resigned, after the board consulted US officials, according to the Guardian, CNBC, Wired and TechCrunch.

item.title: Gemini App Now Available on Low-Memory Android Phones
item.description: Google has brought the Gemini app to low-memory Android Go devices, after re-architecting it to run on simpler hardware for hundreds of millions of users.

item.title: Nvidia Launches RTX Spark Compact Desktops for Local AI
item.description: Nvidia has launched RTX Spark compact desktops built with Asus, Dell and MSI, offering up to 128GB of unified memory to run AI models and agents locally.

item.title: Anthropic Closes $119.5B IPO as Chipmakers Take a Stake
item.description: Anthropic closes its IPO at $119.5 billion in gross proceeds, with underwriters' option fully exercised and a private placement from AMD, Google and Nvidia.

item.title: OpenAI Uses Its AI Models to Improve Chip Design With AMD
item.description: OpenAI says it uses its models to design chips, cutting circuit area on Jalapeño and improving AMD GPU performance, according to the company's statement.

item.title: Anthropic Shares Sink on Day Two, Dragging Nasdaq Lower
item.description: Anthropic shares fall 9% on their second Nasdaq trading day, nearing the IPO price, as the drop drags down Nvidia and Asian markets, CNBC and Guardian report.

item.title: Meta Expands Its Personal AI Agent Muse to Australia Market
item.description: Meta brings its personal AI agent Muse to Australia, with local partners including Canva, Domain and Kogan, according to the company's own announcement.

item.title: Anthropic Mathematician Claims Proof of the Riemann Hypothesis
item.description: An Anthropic mathematician says he proved the Riemann Hypothesis with Claude in a 250,000-page proof written in Lean that has not been independently verified.

item.title: Apple Posts, Then Pulls, Listing for a Computer-Using AI Agent
item.description: Apple posted, then quietly pulled, a job listing to lead an AI agent able to run a computer on its own, according to Bloomberg, TechCrunch and The Verge.

item.title: String of US Outages Reignites Debate Over AI's Role
item.description: A wave of outages at Microsoft, the FAA, banks and Apple Pay has split experts over whether AI is to blame for the failures, per TechCrunch and Wired.

item.title: Anthropic Founders Cash Out $2 Billion as Big Tech Doubles Down
item.description: Anthropic's IPO filings show its founders cashed out $280 million each while Amazon and Google ended up with 28% of the company, per TechCrunch and Fortune.

item.title: Trump Threatens 'Tremendous Tax' on US Firms' Overseas Data Centers
item.description: President Trump threatened to tax US companies that build data centers abroad, saying the move surprised his own staff, according to CNBC and The Verge reports.

item.title: Google Brings Computer Use Automation to Gemini's Mac App
item.description: Google adds Computer Use automation to the Gemini Mac app, letting the assistant click, type and operate other local apps, SiliconANGLE and Engadget report.

item.title: Google Turns Gemini Into a Task-Doing Agent, Free in Six Countries
item.description: Google rolls out a free Tasks mode in Gemini across six countries, using the new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model to book appointments, pay bills and shop, it says.

item.title: Microsoft and Salesforce Launch Copilotforce Sales Integration
item.description: Microsoft and Salesforce launch Copilotforce, an integration bringing Salesforce customer data into Copilot and Teams, with a plugin now in public preview.

item.title: Anthropic Debuts on Nasdaq, Market Cap Tops $2 Trillion Mark
item.description: Anthropic began trading on the Nasdaq 34% above its IPO price, hitting a $2 trillion cap in the largest IPO on record by funds raised, per CNBC and Fortune.

item.title: Microsoft Launches AI Transparency Initiative With 40 Partners
item.description: Microsoft unveiled an AI Transparency Initiative at Ignite, working with Adobe, Accenture and 40 partners to build shared standards for verifying AI agents.

item.title: Microsoft Unveils Always-On Copilot Agent at Ignite 2026
item.description: Microsoft unveiled Autopilot, an always-on AI agent, and Copilot Workspaces, a shared document canvas for people and agents, at its Ignite 2026 conference.

item.title: Google's Gemini 4 Neon Undercuts Rivals on Price and Speed
item.description: Google launched Gemini 4 Neon, a new midtier AI model with a 1-million-token context window, priced below comparable OpenAI and Anthropic rival models.

item.title: Nvidia Stops Shipping Licensed Hopper AI Chips to China
item.description: Nvidia stopped shipping licensed Hopper (H200) chips to China, interim CEO Colette Kress said, as the US tightens export rules, TechCrunch and CNBC report.
